useFor: Opening hook in the first five seconds
Series kicker with a single headline
avoidFor: Anything that needs more than one headline

useFor: One idea with an optional supporting line
Turning a tension into a plain sentence
avoidFor: Lists of three or more items

useFor: One verified number from a claim of kind number
avoidFor: Estimates or rounded figures not held by a claim
Scenes without a verified number claim

useFor: Before and after, or what the evidence says against what the product does
Two lists of up to four items each
Two to four plain conditions or requirements
Ordered steps of a process, two to five
How a flow runs from start to end
avoidFor: Dates that are not in a verified source

useFor: A verified quote from a named speaker, up to 220 characters
avoidFor: Quotes without a verified claim of kind quote

useFor: A short licensed excerpt that the narration points at, 15 seconds at most
avoidFor: Standard-licence clips without the owner's decision (short quote, quote card or both)

useFor: The owner's opinion, always labelled My take
The practitioner view after the evidence
avoidFor: Opinion that has no evidence scene before it

useFor: The closing question to the audience
Desktop and profile pointers on the final frame
